summary: Part 1 of 1 of '0.0 Revibe Ecosystem (KAM)' (07:04). The trainer walks through an 11-page PDF deck: the 'Sellers' journey' diagram (Onboarding, then Journey) and the 'Onboarding process' table (page 2). He covers the onboarding steps and their durations, the interview questions and assets to present, the two order channels (Buybox and Fulfillment App), the Revibe App and Seller portal, and the scoring system that affects prices. Several screen and narration conflicts are logged as unclear, and the deck footer dates it to 2024.

screens.name: Sellers' journey slide deck (PDF viewer, 11 pages)
screens.shows: Two-part diagram. Onboarding column: Onboarding App (Legal clearance, Revibe terms and conditions, Quality guidelines), then Quality check (Send 20/30 pieces to our lab, Quality check), leading to Onboarded (If quality is good) or Rejected (If quality is not good). Journey column: Buybox (Set prices for direct shipping, 3 country flags), Seller, Fulfillment App (Set prices and quantities for fulfillment shipping, 2 country flags), Revibe App (Manage orders received, Interact with Revibe team, Invoices and payments, Manage warranties / returns), Seller portal (Dashboard, Get access to all apps, Get access to all trainings). Arrows labelled 'Get orders' and 'Score affecting prices'.
screens.where: PDF viewer, page indicator reads 'Page N sur 11' in French UI on some frames; the deck's own page number sits bottom-right on every slide

screens.name: Onboarding process table (slide page 2)
screens.shows: Six rows with duration and content: Interview 1h; Legal & admin clearance Auto; Reception & quality check 2 days; Account creation & sales 1h; Trainings 1 day; Trial period 2 weeks. asr_fixes.basis: The deck logo and body text read 'Revibe' (frame t00000, and 'Revibe terms and conditions' on frames t00020 and t00040). The narrator says 'Revive' for the brand on several lines after 03:46.
Frame t00040 shows 'Revibe terms and conditions' highlighted in the Onboarding App box.
Frame t00090 (and t00245), Interview row: 'Present Revibe main assets: orders, simple processes, KAMs team, care team...'.
Frame t00322 and frame t00000 show the box labelled 'Buybox'.
Revibe spelling on the deck logo and in the Revibe App box (frame t00365) and the Revibe App and Seller portal boxes.
Deck logo reads 'REVIBE' on frame t00348 (page 8). Narration says 'Revive does not handle the shipment in Saudi'.

unclear.issue: The narrator says 'Then through another app, the fulfillment app, sellers will have to send between 20, 30 pieces'. On screen the Quality check box sits in the Onboarding column (frames t00000, t00040), and the Fulfillment App is a separate Journey box with no quality check. Which app runs the quality check cannot be confirmed from the video.

Conflict between screen and narration on commission. Slide 2 (frame t00090) lists 'no commission' among Revibe's main assets, but the narrator says 'talk to him about our commission system the fact that we pay them on a weekly basis'. Whether Revibe charges a commission cannot be determined from this video.

The narrator says 'One temporary part, the onboarding part and usual seller journey.' The slide headings are 'Onboarding' and 'Journey' and nothing on screen says the onboarding part is temporary, so the word 'temporary' cannot be confirmed.
The narrator says 'Revive is a bigger set for him.' The phrase is unclear (possibly a mis-hearing) and is not on screen, so the intended meaning cannot be stated.
The narrator says 'and {countries?} we are opening', and the new markets are never named in the video or on screen, so which countries are meant is unknown.
The scoring system is mentioned and its arrows appear on slide 11 (frames t00395, t00415), but neither the narration nor the screen says how the score is calculated or how much it changes prices.

Narration says the seller is onboarded if 'the majority of the quality is good' (03:20) or 'most of the products' are rejected (00:58), while the slide only says 'If quality is good' and 'If quality is not good'. The exact threshold is not shown on screen.

outdated.signal: Every slide footer reads 'Copyright © 2024' (frame t00000), so the deck is dated 2024 and may not match the current process.
The narrator says 'the new markets that we are opening right now' and does not name them, so this is time-bound and may be out of date.
